'''Cloburi Freight''' was a civilian shipping company that ferried supplies to various buyers across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

One of Cloburi's convoys was attacked in the [[Belat system/Legends|Belat system]] by prototype [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from the [[TIE Experimental Project]], which was being conducted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Hopelessly outgunned, the civilian [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] sent a distress signal to a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] convoy en route to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']]. The Alliance sent two of its [[A-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to respond to the attack.

When the two pilots arrived, one of them being [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]], the convoy's lead ship, ''[[Calico]]'', pleaded for the Rebels to ward off the attacking starfighters, which were hammering the fleet's two [[Star Galleon-class frigate|Star Galleons]]. The Rebels were surprised by the radical design of the Imperial starfighters, later classified as the remote-controlled [[TIE Experimental M1]]. They began to suspect that the Empire was fielding new and far more battle-worthy starfighters that sacrificed the necessity for actual pilots. Nevertheless, the confused Rebels were successful in destroying all enemy forces and saving most of the convoy. The ''Calico'' thanked the Rebels for their assistance and continued onward towards their destination.
